scope: Six selected repository metadata checks and bounded primary-source/native-API research. Current upstream HEAD is distinct from the version/commit actually executed in each receipt. No universal SOTA or full-source audit claim.

decisions.reason: Installed5.58.0 has complementary SGML header views: one retains acceptance/items, the other identity/filers. Combine them with strict existing provenance checks; no dependency upgrade or filing reacquisition.
decisions.acceptance_status: Bounded offline native SDK dataset accepted; no fresh acquisition.

decisions.reason: Existing local AAPL sample spans split and dividend adjustments. Native factor/map semantics can be exercised without another data framework. Full-history adjusted prices are retrospective; ScaledRaw is a normalization primitive, not evidence of historical source receipt.
decisions.acceptance_status: Direct native API probe accepted; upstream NUnit host aborted with0cases.

decisions.reason: Installed0.44.0 provides native stock bars and corporate-action clients. Basic historical data starts2016; historical SIP older than15minutes does not intrinsically require a paid live-feed plan. Authentication remains mandatory. Installed CorporateActionsRequest lacks current REST region/data_quality; default complete-only results do not prove comprehensive events.
decisions.acceptance_status: No authenticated acquisition in this wave. Future request must explicitly select SIP, RAW, symbol-asof, dates, pagination and reconcile API drift; no TradingClient.

decisions.reason: Basic public offer advertises two years of end-of-day data and account/key access. Split adjustment excludes dividends; source terms and redistribution must be established independently of SDK license. No duplicate installation or account acquisition.

Corporate-action schema distinguishes issuer/security/listing identities, delistings and record/creation timestamps. SDK license does not provide dataset entitlement or prove point-in-time universe completeness.

Current README emphasizes macro/factor sources; it does not justify promising a maintained authoritative stock-history downloader. Existing role can remain conditional; no new install or replacement price plane.

additional_primary_sources.finding: Current symbol directories and file creation time do not reconstruct a historical delisted universe.

stopping_basis: Existing EdgarTools, DuckDB and LEAN cover this bounded acceptance. Account-backed history and a historically observed universe remain explicit subsequent gates. Additional runtimes do not substitute for those inputs.
